root_cause: The native <dialog> element's showModal() does not reliably focus the autofocus element in this environment. The Drawer component (which extends DialogBase) lacks explicit focus management after opening, leaving keyboard focus on the trigger button or body instead of moving into the drawer.
repair_strategy: Override _show in Drawer to await the base show lifecycle (which handles animations and fires 'shown'), then explicitly focus the autofocus element (or fall back to the dialog itself) so keyboard users land inside the drawer immediately.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus moves into the drawer when opened, landing on the search field so users can immediately type or Tab to filters without a pointer.
functional_risks: Potential focus theft if autofocus element is not focusable (mitigated by fallback to dialog).
Risk of double-focus if browser already moved focus (mitigated by awaiting base show completion).
verification_requirements: After activating the drawer button with Enter, focus is on #filters-search.
Pressing Tab moves focus to #in-stock checkbox.
Closing the drawer with Escape returns focus to the trigger button.
